releases.body:
fix: Remove 'cc' alias

This release reverts the addition of the 'cc' alias (claude --allow-dangerously-skip-permissions) which was intended for local use only.

feat: Add shorthand aliases for opentmux and claude

- `oc` -> `opentmux`
- `cc` -> `claude --allow-dangerously-skip-permissions`

fix: Configure npm OIDC trusted publishing correctly

This release fixes the OIDC publishing configuration to enable automated npm releases via GitHub Actions.

## [1.5.3](https://github.com/AnganSamadder/opentmux/compare/v1.5.2...v1.5.3) (2026-02-10)


### Bug Fixes
